<function=python>

def snap(tag):
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    R=[(min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])) for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='R' and n['pixels']>=12 and n['boundary'][0][0]<50]
    b=[(min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])) for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='b' and n['pixels']>=12 and n['boundary'][0][0]<50]
    N=[(min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])) for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']>=12 and n['boundary'][0][0]<50]
    cells=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('w','g') and 14<=n['boundary'][0][0]<=40:
            for p in n['boundary']:
                if 16<=p[1]<=48: cells.append((p[0],p[1]))
    beam=(min(c[0] for c in cells),max(c[0] for c in cells),max(c[1] for c in cells)) if cells else None
    P=[(n['boundary'][0][0]) for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='M' and n['boundary'][0][0]<50]
    print(tag,"beam(r0,r1,L)",beam,"P",P,"R",R,"b",b,"N",N)

<parameter=code>
def snap(tag):
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    R=[(min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])) for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='R' and n['pixels']>=12 and n['boundary'][0][0]<50]
    b=[(min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])) for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='b' and n['pixels']>=12 and n['boundary'][0][0]<50]
    N=[(min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])) for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']>=12 and n['boundary'][0][0]<50]
    cells=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('w','g') and 14<=n['boundary'][0][0]<=40:
            for p in n['boundary']:
                if 16<=p[1]<=48: cells.append((p[0],p[1]))
    beam=(min(c[0] for c in cells),max(c[0] for c in cells),max(c[1] for c in cells)) if cells else None
    P=[(n['boundary'][0][0]) for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='M' and n['boundary'][0][0]<50]
    print(tag,"beam(r0,r1,L)",beam,"P",P,"R",R,"b",b,"N",N)
